description: MainActivity.kt, the primary activity for an Android calculator app implementing UI logic, expression evaluation, history management, and voice input integration.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main activity responsible for handling the calculator interface, user interactions, and history panel.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up event listeners, and manages activity startup logic.

methods.name: updateResultBox
methods.description: Updates calculation result display and manages undo-redo state.

methods.name: setupUndoRedoButtons
methods.description: Initializes undo and redo button click handlers and updates their enabled state.

methods.name: updateUndoRedoButtonStates
methods.description: Enables/disables undo and redo buttons based on the current state.

methods.name: evaluateAndShowResult
methods.description: Evaluates the arithmetic expression and displays the result or error message.

methods.name: wireCalculatorKeypad
methods.description: Connects UI calculator buttons to input logic and expression building.

methods.name: setupHistoryPanel
methods.description: Configures the history drawer toggle button and overlay interactions.

methods.name: showHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Displays the calculation history drawer with animation.

methods.name: hideHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Hides the calculation history drawer with animation.

methods.name: populateHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Populates the history drawer UI with saved calculation entries.

methods.name: updateHistoryPanelIfVisible
methods.description: Refreshes history display if the drawer is active.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for theme toggling.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, including theme toggle.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between light and dark themes.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from voice recognition activities.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Processes permission request results for voice input.
